title: Claude Automated System #shorts #claude #automatedsystem #aiagent #ai
description:
In this video, I break down a Claude AI agent system that can help local businesses respond to leads faster, book more appointments, follow up automatically, and recover old customers.

This system starts when a lead fills out a website form. From there, Claude can text the lead, answer questions about pricing or availability, book the appointment, follow up by SMS and email, send the business owner a full lead brief, request reviews after the job, and even create personalized win-back messages for past customers.

This is for local business owners, service businesses, contractors, clinics, agencies, and anyone who wants to understand how AI agents can be used to build a real sales and follow-up system.

If you are interested in using Claude, AI automation, or building a system like this for your business, this video shows the full concept.

Comment “AGENT” if you want this exact system.
